_comment: CANONICAL MODEL RATE CARD — source of truth for the 'ai-model-rates' KVM, key 'rate_card'.
Push with: apigee/scripts/sync_rate_card.sh --org <org> --env <env>
Rates are USD per 1,000,000 tokens (Vertex AI PAYG list price).
RULES:
1. Every key here MUST be a model that exists in this project. Verify with
GET https://aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/publishers/{google|anthropic}/models/{id}
before adding one. Three non-existent Claude IDs previously sat in this KVM.
2. Every entitled model MUST appear here. A model that is granted in an API product
but missing from this card is silently billed at the 'default' rate.
3. 'tier' is a COST band, not an entitlement. Bands by output rate:
4. Do NOT infer tier from the model name. gemini-3.5-flash ($9.00 out) costs more than
gemini-3.8-flash ($3.75 out), and Pro ($12.00 out) is the most expensive Gemini here.
Retired 2026-10: gemini-3.7-flash (deprecated), gemini-3.1-flash-lite -> gemini-3.5-flash-lite,
gemini-3-flash-preview -> gemini-3.5-flash. The successors were verified callable on Vertex.
The three retired keys stay here (entitled by no product) ONLY so historical analytics keep
their real price; server.js re-costs past traffic from this card. Same rule as gemini-2.5-flash.
Prices verified 2026-10-10 (Vertex AI Standard, global, prompts <= 200K tokens).
Sources:
https://cloud.google.com/gemini-enterprise-agent-platform/generative-ai/pricing
https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing
gemini-3.6-flash, gemini-3.8-flash and gemini-3.7-flash step up to 1.50 / 7.50 (tier high) on 2027-01-01: update then.
Retired 2026-10 (2): gemini-3.5-flash (deprecated 2026-10-08) -> gemini-3.6-flash; claude-haiku-4-5 -> claude-haiku-5-5;
claude-opus-4-5 -> claude-opus-5-5. Retired keys stay priced for historical analytics.
claude-haiku-5-5 is 0.10 / 0.50 for prompts <= 100K tokens (0.50 / 2.50 above). Claude 5.5 is served on the global endpoint.
